about: Handguns of Skyrim firearms (wall-buys and the Coffer) plus spell tomes and grimoires (Coffer only). Damage in design units. projectile: tracer each shot (sheet: projectiles) for guns; tomes use their spell.

rows.label: Halo of the Apprentice
rows.abilityText: Arcane bolts that never run dry
rows.chargeText: a lance of force through everything in the line

rows.label: Plaguebringer
rows.abilityText: Plague bolts: the sickness eats them and jumps to the next when they fall
rows.chargeText: a plague bursts outward, infecting every zombie near the impact

rows.label: Soulbinder
rows.abilityText: Three soul bolts per cast; kills feed you points
rows.chargeText: homing souls rip into the five nearest

rows.label: Ancestral Seed
rows.abilityText: Thorn bolts that root the dead in place
rows.chargeText: roots burst from the ground and hold everything near the impact

rows.label: Crimson Heartbeat
rows.abilityText: Bloodthirst: every hit heals you
rows.chargeText: drains every foe around you

rows.label: Wand of the Grave
rows.abilityText: Grave burst: staggers the dead
rows.chargeText: roots everything in front of you

rows.label: Moonshard Wand
rows.abilityText: Moonshard: pierces 3
rows.chargeText: a moonbeam through every foe

rows.label: Hexbinder
rows.abilityText: Hex bolts: hexed zombies take half again as much damage
rows.chargeText: every zombie nearby is marked; marked zombies explode when they die and set off the ones around them

rows.label: Mindbreaker
rows.abilityText: Mind bolts daze whatever they hit
rows.chargeText: every zombie near the impact turns on its own kind for eight seconds

rows.label: Event Horizon
rows.abilityText: Gravity bolts that drag the dead toward the impact
rows.chargeText: a singularity pulls every zombie in, then collapses

rows.label: Starforge Spire
rows.abilityText: Star bolts pierce through three zombies in a line
rows.chargeText: six stars fall one after another around where you aim

rows.label: Sixth Heaven
rows.abilityText: Holy fire: bursts on impact and burns the undead
rows.chargeText: a sunburst that scorches everything around the impact

rows.label: Cinderwing
rows.abilityText: Fire arrows: burst and set the dead burning
rows.chargeText: a full draw calls a meteor down where it lands

rows.label: Rimefang
rows.abilityText: Ice arrows slow everything they hit
rows.chargeText: a full draw freezes everything around the impact solid

rows.label: Stormstring
rows.abilityText: Lightning arrows arc to two more
rows.chargeText: a full draw chains lightning through ten of them

rows.label: Galecaller
rows.abilityText: Wind arrows that stagger whatever they hit
rows.chargeText: a full draw looses the Unrelenting Force: everything ahead is blown away

rows.label: Grimoire of Madness
rows.abilityText: Madness
rows.chargeText: madness takes every foe nearby

rows.label: Grimoire of the Thu'um
rows.abilityText: Unrelenting Force
rows.chargeText: the full shout: everything flies

rows.label: Grimoire of the Skyforge
rows.abilityText: Chain lightning
rows.chargeText: lightning chains through twelve foes

rows.label: Apprentice's Tome
rows.abilityText: Firebolts
rows.chargeText: pierces everything in a line

rows.label: Giant's Hearth
rows.abilityText: Ember bolts that burst where they land
rows.chargeText: six meteors fall around you and everything near you burns

rows.label: Gildergreen Bough
rows.abilityText: Sap-light bolts that knit your wounds as they kill
rows.chargeText: roots every zombie near you in living wood and heals you whole

rows.label: Heart of Lorkhan
rows.abilityText: Tonal bolts that knock the dead off their feet
rows.chargeText: time stops for every zombie near you, then they shatter

rows.label: Arkay's Last Rite
rows.abilityText: Grave-light bolts that hunt the nearest dead
rows.chargeText: Arkay's judgement strikes down every undead near you

rows.label: Hjaalmarch Mirestaff
rows.abilityText: Marsh bolts whose plague jumps when they die
rows.chargeText: a sucking bog drags them all in while the plague spreads through them

rows.label: Eye of Magnus
rows.abilityText: Arcane lances that pierce four of the dead
rows.chargeText: three crystal eyes rise and burn the dead with beams for eight seconds

rows.label: Wolf Queen's Longbow
rows.abilityText: Necromantic arrows that daze the dead
rows.chargeText: a volley of nine arrows; every zombie it strikes turns on its own kind

rows.label: Ysgramor's Stormbow
rows.abilityText: Stalhrim arrows whose frost-lightning arcs to two more
rows.chargeText: a blizzard of ice and lightning falls on twelve of them at once

rows.label: Nightingale's Shadowbow
rows.abilityText: Shadow arrows that hex the dead for more damage
rows.chargeText: every zombie in sight is marked for Nocturnal; each one that falls takes the next with it

rows.label: Vaermina's Dreamstring
rows.abilityText: Dream-fire arrows that burst on impact
rows.chargeText: ten burning stars fall from a dreaming sky
